description:

Cisco Intersight is a cloud-based system management platform for Cisco UCS (Unified Computing System) and many other products which enables IT organizations to analyse, simplify and automate their environments. It is driven by analytics and machine learning to provide actionable intelligence for IT operations/management.

This is a unique opportunity to be part of a dynamic core team and help shape the future of compute, network and storage management technology as well as product direction.

A successful candidate will bring deep technical expertise especially in cloud native technologies and ability to work within a fast moving, start-up like environment to deliver solid code that has a broad business impact. We are looking for candidates driven by the challenge of solving unique and difficult technical problems, who thrive and excel when given creative freedom.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate a system-level focus while understanding the impact of every component. Broad knowledge of and exposure to system management software are essential for success in this role.

* Experience working on SaaS Enterprise Software or Cloud Infrastructure with exposure to Microservices architecture.
* Solid knowledge of Object-Oriented Concepts and Design.
* Fundamentally strong in Data Structures and Algorithms.
* Expertise in programming languages like GoLang, Java or C/C++.

* Experience with AWS.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills.

* Independent, accountable, strong sense of ownership, aggressive, communicative, sense of urgency and flexible/adaptable.
* A passion for quality, for doing the right thing for the customers, the product, and for the company.

Requirements: B.E./M.Tech. with 2+ years of experience.
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

title: Senior ABAP Developer
description:
W ABB pomagamy przemysłowi wyprzedzać konkurencję – dzięki większej wydajności i czystszym procesom. Postęp jest podstawą – dla Ciebie, Twojego zespołu i całego świata. Jako światowy lider rynku zapewnimy Ci wszystko, czego potrzebujesz, aby osiągnąć sukces. Nie zawsze będzie to łatwe, ponieważ rozwój wymaga determinacji. Jednak w ABB nigdy nie będziesz działać w pojedynkę. Kieruj tym, co napędza świat.
  
  
**This Position Reports To**
IS Manager
  
  
In this role, you will build and support the SAP ABAP solutions that run our business as one of the first developers on a new central development team. Each day, you will write production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA: reports, enhancements, interfaces, forms, and posting logic. You will work directly with the business users who depend on that code. You will also showcase your experience by taking on work across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales as priorities shift, and by bringing practical clean core judgment to our S/4HANA journey. You will learn and use the agentic AI development platforms the team is adopting, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct.
  
  
In this role, you will report to the ABAP Development Lead, work as an individual contributor, and have no people management responsibilities.
  
  
The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office.
  
  
This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the ABAP Development Lead; functional consultants; the SAP BTP and integration teams; and SAP Basis.
  
  
**You Will Be Mainly Accountable For**

* Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC every week, closing your commitments on the date you gave, chasing what is blocked, and following up after go-live until the problem is really solved.
* Bridging to S/4HANA: contributing to S/4HANA Public Cloud stabilization and Private Cloud planning using CDS, RAP and ABAP Cloud, and choosing standard extensibility over classic enhancement where it fits.
* Working directly with the business: sitting with the people who have the problem, understanding the process and configuration behind it, and building what they actually need.
* Working to the team standard: following coding guidelines, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, reviewing colleagues' code, and using AI-assisted development within the team's rules.

**Our team dynamics**
You will become part of a small, collaborative team where everyone contributes and supports one another. AI is part of how we work, and we will help you get started if you are new to it. Done means it is being used by the business, not just transported, and a straightforward “I don’t know yet” is welcome.
  
  
**Qualifications For The Role**

* You have more than 8 years of SAP development experience, with deep current ABAP knowledge in ECC, including enhancements, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, OData, and REST interfaces, plus performance optimization.
* You show a consistent ability to deliver production outcomes that can be measured, including initiatives that were delayed before you inherited them.
* You have practical SAP S/4HANA experience, including CDS views and a solid understanding of clean core principles.
* You enjoy working directly with business users and understanding the process and configuration behind a requirement, not only the specification.
* You have established skills in working to a shared development standard, including code review, ABAP Test Cockpit, and transport discipline, in onshore/offshore or multi-team environments.
* You are open to AI-assisted development and ready to learn agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct. Prior AI experience.
* You are comfortable using English in both conversation and writing.

**What's in it for you?**
You will work on code that keeps a global business running and help shape how a new central team builds. You’ll have direct experience with the latest agentic AI tools for SAP development, along with guidance as you learn them. You can grow into a techno-functional or value stream role, or technical leadership, and we will support you on either path.
  
  
**More About Us (Mandatory)**
At ABB, we help shape digital industries and power grids while supporting sustainable change in a wide range of sectors. Our division is recognized as a trusted partner delivering forward-looking insights that fuel sustainable growth. We cultivate a workplace that values diversity, inclusion, and belonging across gender, ethnicity, LGBTQ+ identities, abilities, and generations, so every voice is heard.
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).
  
  
If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.
  
  
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.
